title: I wish they'd just pay
caption:
I wish they'd just pay.

You are out of the office, the client pays when it suits them, and "Invoice paid" is waiting in your Snap inbox when you look up.
Payments go straight to your own Stripe account with 0% commission.

It is not magic: you still have to send the invoice. Snap just tells you the moment it is paid.

Start free at snaphq.app
